 The San Jose State Spartans take on the Air Force Falcons in Colorado. Kickoff is set for 7:00 p.m. EST on CBS Sports Network.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Air Force is favored by 11.5 points on the spread with a moneyline of -490. The total is set at 47.5 points.
 Here's my San Jose State vs. Air Force prediction and college football pick for Saturday, November 14, 2026.
 San Jose State vs. Air Force Pick: Under 47.5 
 My Air Force vs. San Jose State best bet is on the Under. Find the best line available on our live NCAAF odds page .
 San Jose State vs Air Force Odds
 San Jose State vs Air Force point spread : Air Force -12 (-112 ), San Jose State +12 (-110)
 San Jose State vs Air Force over/under : 47.5 (-110o / -110u)
 San Jose State vs Air Force moneyline : San Jose State +370, Air Force -490
 Let's talk about a triple-option team.
 This is a bad spot for the Flyboys coming off their big win last week over Army (which clinched the Commander-in-Chief's Trophy for the second time in the past decade). It also might be tough for them to switch their mindset back to Mountain West play after a few weeks off.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement We know what we're getting with Air Force's offense: Low and Slow.
 We'll see the fullback dive, the quarterback iso, and the quarterback follow. It'll be the classic ground-and-pound system.
 Additionally, Ken Niumatalolo knows how to stop the option, and his Spartans have a very stout run defense. I think we'll see Air Force struggle to establish consistent, methodical drives.
 On the other side, San Jose State is looking for around three or four possessions that end in scores, as possessions will be very limited in this game.
 The Spartans have been a dead-set Under team for most of the season, and they haven't played a 50-plus-point game since Week 1 against USC. They run the ball a lot, and they aren't very explosive through the air — I don't think they'll be able to attack Air Force's secondary, which is the weak link on that defense.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Pick: Under 47.5
